release_notes: Redesigned Download File Info dialog with a Windows 11-style branded header, file hero card, icon-led fields, server information card and an animated Start Download action.

Working Download File Info dialog for manual and browser downloads, with category detection, editable file name and folder, a remembered folder per category, an optional description and honest server metadata.
HEAD metadata with an aborting Range GET fallback reports size, type, last modified, resume support and server status without downloading the file.
Start Download, Download Later and Cancel are real actions; later tasks persist in the queue across restarts and start from the Queue Manager.
Browser downloads open the same dialog and the browser copy is cancelled only after IDM creates the task; cancelling resumes the original browser download.
Database schema v5 adds description and start_later after a verified backup; existing downloads, settings and partial files are preserved.
